closingHostRun.name: Host Emulated Acceptance
closingHostRun.display_title: fix: complete Host frontend parity with emulated provider checks

head_commit.message:
fix(test): persist I386 observations before Release acknowledgement

Publish completed TEST observation rows before either successful broker exit and refuse incomplete writes through the existing failure path.
Retain only the closed reply status in the original Main admission refusal; keep all original clocks and acceptance checks.

repository.name: agent-teams-ai
repository.description: You're the boss, agents are your team. They handle tasks on their own, message each other, and review each other's work. You just watch the kanban board and give high-level commands. Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Cursor/Grok/GitHub/Kiro/Z.AI/Xiaomi/MiniMax/Kimi(300+ models, 200+ LLM providers, free models no auth) Build your AI company with multiple teams
